empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill from scratch or import one from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import a .md or .zip file — you'll see the full body before it's saved.
drawer.untrustedNotice: This body is inserted into the trusted part of the agent's prompt without being wrapped as untrusted data. Read it fully before confirming.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The description IS the skill's interface — the agent reads it to decide when this skill applies to a review.

previewTab.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
previewTab.empty: Nothing to preview yet — add a body in Config.
previewTab.untrustedNotice: This skill was imported from a file and is rendered as-is — vet its body before enabling it for an agent.

stats.noAgents: No agents use this skill yet.

versionsTab.caption: Every save of the body snapshots a new version. Editing name, description, type or enabled does not.
versionsTab.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with v{version}'s body — the history is kept.
